effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a face-up security card, gain 1 memory.
[Main] By suspending this Tamer, digivolve 1 of your Digimon into a Digimon card in your face-up security cards. If this effect digivolved, you may place 1 Digimon card with the [Royal Base] trait from your hand face-up as your bottom security card.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
